ios.desc:
Every country you've been to, counted automatically. Day 31 tracks your travels as they happen, keeps a day count for every country, US state, or territory, and works completely offline - your data stays private on your device. Built for wanderlust first, it is also your tax residency and visa companion: select your locations, set minimum or maximum day limits, and simply track.

▶ Privacy: Your personal data stays where it belongs - on your device. 

▶ Offline: Day 31 works completely offline so you can stay updated, no internet required.

▶ Set Limits: Easily define min/max day limits for all countries, US States & Territories, and monitor your progress. Stay ahead with customized alerts.

▶ Automatic Location Tracker: Your timeline updates automatically based on your location.

▶ Timeline: Update and review your travel timeline. Easily see a summary day count per jurisdiction for any reporting period.

▶ Photo to Timeline: Generate travel timeline in seconds completely offline using location data from photos without accessing the actual contents. 

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://day31.app/company/privacy
